eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Honolulu, HI; at 5:49 PM on AUG 19, 2025 Effective until 6:49 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
From Oahu Emergency Management. An Evacuation Order has been issued due to a WILDLAND FIRE in Kunia. The evacuation area includes: Kunia Camp and Kunia Headstart School, at Kunia Drive and Kunia Road. Visibility in area will be reduced and roads can become blocked; if you do not leave now, you could be trapped, injured, or killed. LEAVE NOW from evacuated areas! Check alert.hnlalert.gov for updates or monitor local radio and TV stations. Stay out of the area until further notice.  

Call 9 1 1 for emergencies only. Do not call 9 1 1 for information or non-emergency situations.
